reading.title: Plate Tectonics and Continental Drift
reading.passage: The theory of plate tectonics revolutionized geology by explaining how Earth's lithosphere is divided into rigid plates that constantly move. These plates interact at boundaries, causing earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and mountain formation. Continental drift, proposed by Alfred Wegener, suggests that continents gradually migrate across the ocean floor due to mantle convection currents beneath the crust. Evidence includes matching fossils on separated continents and seafloor magnetic patterns that confirm plate movement rates of several centimeters annually.

questions.q: According to the passage, what causes the movement of tectonic plates?
options: A) Gravitational pull from the moon
B) Mantle convection currents
C) Magnetic field fluctuations
D) Ocean water pressure
questions.explanation: 지문에서 '맨틀 대류 때문에 판이 점진적으로 이동한다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What can be inferred from the passage about evidence supporting continental drift?
options: A) It is purely theoretical with no physical evidence
B) Only fossil records prove the theory
C) Multiple types of evidence exist, including fossils and seafloor patterns
D) Magnetic patterns alone are sufficient proof
questions.explanation: 지문에서 '분리된 대륙의 일치하는 화석과 해저 자기 패턴'이 증거로 제시되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Online education should expand significantly to replace traditional classroom learning in universities. Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

structure.intro: 온라인 교육 확대에 대한 입장을 명확히 제시하고, 2-3개의 주요 이유를 포함한 thesis 작성. 예: 'While online education offers flexibility, traditional classroom learning remains essential for comprehensive university education because of interactive learning, practical skills development, and social engagement.'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유: 대면 상호작용과 실시간 질문의 중요성. 구체적 예: STEM 실험, 그룹 프로젝트, 실습 수업 등이 온라인으로는 제한적임.
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유: 학생의 학습 동기 및 정신 건강. 예: 대학 캠퍼스의 사회적 네트워킹, 멘토링, 학생회 등의 경험이 개인 발전에 필수적.
structure.conclusion: 온라인 교육의 보완적 역할을 인정하면서도, 전면적 대체보다는 하이브리드 모델의 가치를 강조하는 결론.

key_phrases: In my opinion, I believe that...
To summarize, while online learning has benefits...
It is undeniable that traditional classrooms offer...

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer reading books to understand stories. Others prefer watching movies. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and details in your response.
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer reading books because...
On the other hand, movies can...
To sum up, I believe that books provide...
sample_points: 책의 장점: 상상력 활동, 세부 묘사가 풍부, 개인의 속도대로 읽을 수 있음. 예: '판의 라이라' 같은 판타지 소설을 읽을 때 각자 다른 캐릭터를 상상함.
영화의 장점: 시각적 효과, 시간 효율성, 감정 전달 직관성. 예: 대작 영화의 특수효과가 책으로는 표현 불가능.
개인 선호 결론: 어느 쪽이 더 유익한지 명확히 선택하고, 상황에 따라 둘 다 활용하는 균형잡힌 마무리.

listening.title: Thesis Topic Discussion with Professor
listening.script: Professor: Good morning, Sarah. How's your thesis research on erosion patterns in volcanic regions progressing? Student: Hi Professor. Actually, I've been reviewing geological surveys from the Cascade Range, and I'm finding some interesting discrepancies. The erosion rates don't match the existing models. Professor: That's promising. Can you elaborate? Student: Well, I noticed that water flow during rainy seasons creates more erosion than predicted. I think we need to factor in seasonal climate variations. Professor: Excellent observation. Have you considered how this might relate to plate movement? Student: Not yet, but that's a great point. The volcanic terrain is still geologically active, so maybe the subterranean activity affects surface erosion. Professor: Precisely. I suggest you investigate the relationship between tectonic activity and erosion rates. You might discover a significant connection. Student: That makes sense. Should I collect new field data? Professor: Yes, supplementary fieldwork would strengthen your argument considerably. Plan for late summer when conditions are more stable.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation between the professor and student?
options: A) The history of volcanic mountain ranges
B) Sarah's thesis research on erosion patterns in volcanic regions
C) Methods for predicting earthquakes
D) Climate change impacts on geology
questions.explanation: 교수와 학생이 화산 지역의 침식 패턴에 대한 Sarah의 논문 연구를 논의하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the professor suggest Sarah should do next?
options: A) Abandon the research due to discrepancies
B) Only review published papers without fieldwork
C) Investigate the relationship between tectonic activity and erosion rates, and conduct supplementary field data collection
D) Focus solely on climate models
questions.explanation: 교수는 지진 활동과 침식률의 관계를 조사하고 여름에 현장 데이터를 수집할 것을 제안합니다.

questions.q: Why does the professor mention seasonal climate variations?
options: A) To criticize Sarah's observation
B) To suggest that climate is unrelated to erosion
C) To support Sarah's discovery about erosion rates not matching existing models
D) To change the topic entirely
questions.explanation: 교수는 Sarah의 발견(물 흐름이 예상보다 침식을 야기함)이 타당하며 계절 기후 변화를 고려해야 함을 인정하고 있습니다.
